messages:
maria_sales: Quick context — passing NovaThrive (mid-market fintech) to CS. Contract signed yesterday. Primary asks: Okta SSO, VPC peering (eu-west-1), dedicated throughput (~2k reqs/min), and data residency. Renewal risk: ~30% if onboarding slips.

liam_cs: Thanks Maria. Assigning Priya to lead onboarding. Priya, can you confirm SSO plan + provisioning ETA? @devon may need to support VPC peering and perf.

priya_cs: Ack. I'll run the kickoff and collect metadata. Need SP/IDP metadata from sales + customer network CIDR. maria_sales — can you drop contact and metadata here?

maria_sales: Dropping contact: sara@novathrive.com and staging Okta metadata: https://okta.example/metadata/sara. Customer provided CIDR: 10.8.0.0/16. CSM kickoff scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT.

ben_support: Flagging infra for Dedicated capacity. I'll open INC-5492 with the config needs and expected traffic. Assigning to infra queue. @devon pls review perf assumptions.

devon_eng: On it. For 2k rps with median ~120 tokens and spikes to ~800, we should pre-warm KV cache and validate batching. Priya — can you share expected prompt set and percent of long reads?

priya_cs: Median ~120 tokens, ~10% long reads up to 800. Sharing prompt set + example warmup script in a GH gist shortly.

maria_sales: Also FYI legal requested SOC2 addendum; Sheila from legal is looped in — potential 1–2 week hold depending on review.

liam_cs: Owners and next steps: Priya = onboarding lead; Ben = infra ticket & capacity estimate; Devon = perf simulations; Maria = customer contact; Sheila = legal review. Action items: 1) Priya collect Okta metadata + CIDR (EOD), 2) Ben create INC-5492 + attach expected token/tps (EOD), 3) Devon run perf sim and post results (48h), 4) Sheila advance SOC2 addendum review. I'll spin up a dedicated check-in channel after kickoff. Risk note: If SSO not completed in 10 days renewal risk increases. :warning:

onboard-bot: Reminder — kickoff event created: 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to participants.

priya_cs: Gist + warmup script attached. Sample warmup:

```bash
# warmup loop for KV cache
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/v1/generate \ 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \ 
    -d '{"prompt": "<sample_prompt>", "max_tokens": 150}' >/dev/null &
done
```
I'll attach these to INC-5492 and update the ticket when done. :thumbsup:
